description: This file defines a C# interface for catalog item services in a Blazor project, specifying asynchronous methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving catalog items.

classes.name: ICatalogItemService
classes.description: An interface defining catalog item-related operations such as create, edit, delete, and retrieval methods asynchronously.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID asynchronously, returning a status string.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by ID asynchronously.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Lists catalog items with pagination support asynchronously.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves the full list of catalog items asynchronously.
